response.title: Pricing
response.text:
Pricing

# ClaimWizard pricing is simple

You only pay for what you need

ClaimWizard is public adjusting claim processing and workflow management software that gets you organized, saves you time, and helps you grow.

### Business Package

$250Starting at Per Month

Includes Up To 3 Assignable Licenses*

- No Setup Fees
- No Signup Fees
- No Contract Required
- Includes Office Staff accounts at no additional cost
- Email & Phone Support During Business Hours
- Each Additional Assignable License* is $50/Month
- A paid Assignable account is required to access the Mobile Application (assignable roles are available for users that need mobile access)
- Restoration Companies & Law Firms must start at this level.

### Enterprise Package

$VariesPrices Issued via Quote

Includes Unlimited Assignable Licenses*

- Everything AND...
- Custom Template Conversion
- Dedicated Account Representative
- Claim Workflow Consultation & Roadmap
- Concierge Support During Extended Business Hours
- Data Migration
- Transition Planning
- And MORE...
- Best for companies that need 50+ licenses

Inquire About an Enterprise Pilot Program (sales@claimwizard.com)

*ClaimWizard provides over 100 assignable roles to support any company size and organizational structure.

Assignable roles cover multiple business types including: Adjusting, Estimating, Appraisal, Law Firm, Construction, Restoration and more.

Are you a ‘solo’ public adjuster that needs the basic features of ClaimWizard and don’t have staff or any additional adjusters? The ClaimWizard $99/Month Single User Package may be the right solution for you.

This package is only available to Public Adjusters that have one adjuster and no staff. Companies with more than one adjuster and/or any staff are not eligible for this tier.

Sign Up For The Single User Package
